get.description: Read a page of objects of a specified type in your HubSpot account. You can control the data returned by specifying desired properties through query parameters. This endpoint is useful for retrieving a list of CRM objects, such as contacts or deals, with optional filtering and pagination.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: The paging cursor token of the last successfully read resource will be returned as the `paging.next.after` JSON property of a paged response containing more results.

parameters.name: archived
parameters.description: Whether to return only results that have been archived.

parameters.name: associations
parameters.description: A comma separated list of object types to retrieve associated IDs for. If any of the specified associations do not exist, they will be ignored.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of results to display per page.

parameters.name: properties
parameters.description: A comma separated list of the properties to be returned in the response. If any of the specified properties are not present on the requested object(s), they will be ignored.

parameters.name: propertiesWithHistory
parameters.description: A comma separated list of the properties to be returned along with their history of previous values. If any of the specified properties are not present on the requested object(s), they will be ignored. Usage of this parameter will reduce the maximum number of objects that can be read by a single request.

link.description: A string URL that provides a direct link to the next page of results, enabling easy navigation.

Provided property values will be overwritten. Read-only and non-existent properties will be ignored. Properties values can be cleared by passing an empty string.

parameters.name: idProperty
parameters.description: The name of a property whose values are unique for this object type

properties.description: An object containing key-value pairs where keys are property names and values are the new property values. Each property value is a string.

schema.description: Represents the input required to update a CRM object, containing an object with property names and their corresponding values.

archived.description: A boolean indicating whether the object is archived.

archivedAt.description: The date and time when this object was archived, in ISO 8601 format.

createdAt.description: The date and time when this object was created, in ISO 8601 format.

id.description: The unique identifier for this object, represented as a string.

objectWriteTraceId.description: A string used for tracing the write operations on this object.

properties.description: A map of property names to their values, where each value is a string.

sourceId.description: A string representing the unique identifier of the source.

sourceLabel.description: A string label that provides a human-readable name for the source.

sourceType.description: A string indicating the type of source from which the value was derived.

timestamp.description: The date and time when the value was recorded, in ISO 8601 format.

updatedByUserId.description: An integer representing the ID of the user who last updated the value.

value.description: The actual value of the property at the given timestamp. It is a string.

items.description: Property model that includes timestamp.

propertiesWithHistory.description: A map of property names to arrays of historical values, each represented by a 'ValueWithTimestamp' object.

updatedAt.description: The date and time when this object was last updated, in ISO 8601 format.

url.description: The URL associated with this object, represented as a string.

warnings.description: An array of warnings related to this object, each represented by a 'PublicObjectWarning' object.

category.description: A string indicating the category of the warning.

context.description: An object providing additional context about the warning, with string properties.

message.description: A string containing the warning message that describes the issue or consideration.

items.description: Represents a warning message related to a public object in HubSpot, providing details about the nature and context of the warning.

get.description: List all associations of an object by object type. This endpoint allows you to retrieve associations between objects, with a limit of 500 associations per call. It is useful for understanding the relationships between different objects in your CRM.

parameters.name: toObjectType
parameters.description: The type of the associated object to retrieve.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: The paging cursor token of the last successfully read resource will be returned as the `paging.next.after` JSON property of a paged response containing more results.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of results to display per page.

after.description: A string token that acts as a cursor to indicate the position after the last successfully read resource, allowing the retrieval of the next page of results.

link.description: A string URL that provides a direct link to the next page of results, enabling easy navigation.

next.description: Specifies the paging information needed to retrieve the next set of results in a paginated API response

paging.description: Paging information for forward-only pagination. Contains the next page reference when more results are available; omitted or empty on the last page.

results.description: An array of objects, each representing an association with multiple labels. Each object includes details about the associated object and the types of associations.

associationTypes.description: An array of association specifications, each with a label, defining the types of associations between objects.

category.description: The category of the association, indicating its origin. Valid values include 'HUBSPOT_DEFINED', 'USER_DEFINED', 'INTEGRATOR_DEFINED', and 'WORK'.

fromObjectTypeId.description: The type ID of the object from which the association originates.

label.description: A string label that provides a human-readable name for the association.

toObjectTypeId.description: The type ID of the object to which the association is directed.

typeId.description: An integer representing the unique identifier for the association type.

items.description: Defines the type, direction, and details of the relationship between two CRM objects.

toObjectId.description: The unique identifier of the object to which associations are being made. It is a string.

items.description: Represents an object that is associated with multiple other objects, with optional context.

schema.description: Represents a paginated collection of objects that are associated with multiple labels, including the results and pagination details. This component is used when retrieving associated objects with specific labels in a forward-paging manner.
